summary_md:
# #450 Feta frippor och andra IPO:er

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This MarketMakers episode is mostly an IPO special. The hosts doubt Avionero because of its huge forecasts and its conflicted commissioned analysis. They are negative on Linjemontage because of its controlling owner and falling earnings, and positive on the Dormy golf-retail IPO at about 8x EV/EBIT. Other topics include Meta's surprise hit with its Muse agent app, the AI IPO wave (OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX), a short-term trade in Coffee Stain on buyback, dividend and DLC catalysts, and a warning that a US diesel export ban would push up global fuel prices.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 COFFEE-B — Coffee Stain | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host holds a small position as a short-term trade on the buyback, 68 öre dividend and likely paid Satisfactory DLC; Pareto top pick and insider buying.

#### Reasoning

Profitable company (35% EBIT margin, ~1bn SEK sales, ~700 MSEK cash) returning ~7% via 3.5% dividend yield plus 3.5% buybacks. A paid Satisfactory DLC at ~$10 could add 1-2% to sales per million copies sold. Stock down ~15% YTD, so sentiment could turn. Wingefors bought 30 MSEK of shares and Pareto has it as a top pick. Explicitly framed as a trigger-based short-term trade; co-host also holds a small position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 29 Sep announcement is not a paid DLC
- if the DLC sells poorly
- once catalysts (buyback, dividend) have played out

> *"jag tycker ju att det här är ett jättefint bolag, men det är en kortsiktig trade och den som sagt triggern lite grann är att det kommer återköp, utdelning och ett troligtvis betalt dels i släpp"*

---

### 🟡 REMEDY — Remedy | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Control Resonant reviews at 83-84 on Metacritic; stock up strongly; host keeps his position.

#### Reasoning

Last week's game release catalyst delivered good reviews and the stock rose. Host keeps the position and hopes it continues, with no new thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if game sales disappoint after launch

> *"Jag har kvar min position och hoppas att axeln ska fortsätta."*

---

### 🟢 DORMY — Dormy | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Golf retail IPO at 8x EV/EBIT with a store moat and structural golf growth; host subscribed and will buy if it trades down.

#### Reasoning

Sweden's largest golf chain. Customers test clubs in store, which protects it from e-commerce, and brand awareness is strong. Sales doubled since 2016 without net new stores. Profits look normalised, not peak. Young players are driving growth. Risks: cyclical, discretionary purchases and the 2021-22 boom-bust. Host expects strong demand and a good first day.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the consumer downturn cuts golf spending
- if earnings prove to be peak-cycle
- if the IPO pops to a much higher valuation

> *"tycker det ser intressant ut om den går ner i morgon, eller när vi släpper det avsnittet, så kommer jag köpa aktier"*

---

### ⛔ LINJEMONTAGE — Linjemontage | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Cheap at 8.5x EV/EBITA with grid-buildout tailwind, but governance red flags and guided sales/profit decline this year.

#### Reasoning

Structural growth from north-south power transmission buildout and a low valuation. But the controlling Indian owner made odd related-party deals: a 50+ MSEK loan to a Brazilian affiliate written to zero and a 150 MSEK Uganda project. The 56.6% CAGR is computed from a weak 2024 base, and the company guides lower sales and profit this year. Host skipped it for the next nine months; might revisit in 2027.

#### Sell Triggers

- if related-party dealings stop and earnings resume growth
- if the valuation falls further, re-evaluate in 2027

> *"Jag tror inte det här är någonting som är så nice att äga kommande nio månader i alla fall."*

---

### ⛔ AVIONERO — Avionero | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Flight-search IPO with almost no real revenue, heavy cash burn, 10 Affärsvärlden red flags and conflicted analysis; hosts declined to advertise it.

#### Reasoning

11 years and 54 MSEK spent on a product that general AI assistants now overtake. Revenue is mainly capitalised work, cash burn is 3 MSEK per half-year, and net proceeds are only ~5 MSEK after ~1 MSEK in issue costs. The pre-IPO was halved. Adviser fees go to an insider. The commissioned 185 MSEK 2035 forecast comes from a research firm cross-linked to Kiwi Games. The 10% of revenue charity pledge was paused.

#### Sell Triggers

- if real revenue traction appears
- if well-funded by institutional investors

> *"Det vore kul om de lyckades, men jag tycker att det här känns lite tveksamt, minst sagt."*

---

### 🟠 FOMO — Formont Group | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

NGM listing combining Finance Lab and Tellus Equity; interesting exposure to rights-issue investing but likely low interest and liquidity.

#### Reasoning

Host finds the business and Ubbe Invest's underwriting track record interesting. However, he hasn't checked the valuation, expects lukewarm demand and poor liquidity, and says it could crash. Framed as something to follow, not a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if liquidity stays poor
- if valuation proves rich

> *"Jag tror att det kan vara ganska svalt intresse för aktien tyvärr. Men jag bara lyfter det ändå."*

---
